87:t_1:89.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's an all-out battle, so the plan's very simple.」

87:t_1:90.en:
$$マオ$$
「The resistance groups will create diversions nearby while we break through at a single point.」

87:t_1:91.en:
$$勝平$$
「A head-on charge! Now that's manly!」

87:t_1:92.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This mission is perfect for us.」

87:t_1:93.en:
$$正太郎$$
「And we can't afford to fail.」

87:t_1:94.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's make sure we pull this off and drive those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards out!」

87:t_1:96.en:
$$パーラ$$
「$$マオ$$, were $$ジャミル$$ and the others among those resistance groups?」

87:t_1:97.en:
$$マオ$$
「Unfortunately, I didn't find any information on your friends.」

87:t_1:98.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's fine. They're bound to be fighting $$サイデリアル$$ anyway.」

87:t_1:99.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If we keep fighting, we'll run into them again somewhere.」

87:t_1:101.en:
$$エイミー$$
「What's wrong, $$ティファ$$? Are you worried about something?」

87:t_1:107.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$ティファ$$ can see a little of the future.」

87:t_1:108.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then 'poison is approaching'... must be a warning of some danger...」

87:t_1:113.en:
$n
「We'll heed your warning. But if we let it scare us, we can't move forward.」

87:t_1:114.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$n's right! Whatever enemies await us, we'll win!」

87:t_1:116.en:
$n
「That's how it is, everyone. Let's make sure this operation succeeds.」

87:t_1:119.en:
$$アルト$$
「Nicely said, $n. Maybe I'll leave next year's $$ボランティア部$$ presidency to you.」

87:t_1:120.en:
$n
「No... I owe it all to our president. I'm counting on you next term, too.」

87:t_1:121.en:
$$甲児$$
「I had my doubts at first, but you're settling into a leadership role as vice president, $n.」

87:t_1:122.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ said people grow to fit the roles they're given.」

87:t_1:123.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, to improve my command abilities, I'll run for president next term...」

87:t_1:126.en:
$$かなめ$$
「With the president, vice president, and manager all in agreement, this discussion is over.」

87:t_1:127.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This is the big battle to free $$翠の地球$$. Good luck, everyone.」

87:t_1:129.en:
$$マオ$$
「The $$クォーター$$ departs in four hours. Finish your machines' final adjustments before then.」

87:t_1:131.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... About what $$ティファ$$ said...」

87:t_1:132.en:
$n
「...I'm done being afraid of my anxiety. I'll overcome it.」

87:t_1:135.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In this battle... I have a feeling the anxiety we've felt until now is going to take a concrete shape...」

87:t_2:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It's no good, as expected. That man $$バルビエル$$'s attack has completely shut down the base.」

87:t_2:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「We took the base, but our plan to use its facilities has gone up in smoke.」

87:t_2:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「With the main battlefield shifting from $$翠の地球$$ to $$蒼の地球$$, this base must no longer matter to $$サイデリアル$$.」

87:t_2:8.en:
$$オズマ$$
「'This planet has its limits'... Perhaps that's connected to the $$レイライン$$s extracting $$次元力$$...」

87:t_2:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...So you were with a resistance group farther east, $$ロラン$$?」

87:t_2:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yeah... It was built around the $$イングレッサ$$ 《$$ミリシャ$$》, so Miss $$ソシエ$$ and $$メシェー$$ were there, too.」

87:t_2:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I came here to join the assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

87:t_2:12.en:
$$パーラ$$
「You didn't bring $$ソシエ$$ and the others?」

87:t_2:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
(It looks like there's something behind that...)

87:t_2:15.en:
$$パーラ$$
(Yeah... We'd better not ask right now.)

87:t_2:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「And you joined up with us on the way.」

87:t_2:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「Uncle $$ランド$$, you knew that $$バルビエル$$ guy, right?」

87:t_2:18.en:
$$ランド$$
「...$$セツコ$$, $$クロウ$$, and I were chasing him.」

87:t_2:19.en:
$$アルト$$
「You were traveling with $$クロウ$$ and the others?」

87:t_2:20.en:
$$ランド$$
「Until we took the $$セントラル・ベース$$ in the northern $$中央大陸$$.」

87:t_2:21.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Oh! I heard a small elite unit took that base with a charge, but...」

87:t_2:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Though $$バルビエル$$ got the better of us in that battle.」

87:t_2:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「He got the better of you... How!?」

87:t_2:25.en:
$$メール$$
「...The truth is, we traveled with $$バルビエル$$ and $$サルディアス$$, the man who came to pick him up, for a while.」

87:t_2:27.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Does that mean... they were spies?」

87:t_2:28.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm still not sure. Rather than simply gathering information, they seemed to be watching our actions.」

87:t_2:29.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then, at the very end, they showed their true colors and turned against us.」

87:t_2:30.en:
$$ランド$$
「They left us one hell of a parting gift...」

87:t_2:31.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you're that serious about it, it must've been something awful.」

87:t_2:32.en:
$$ランド$$
「After we took that $$セントラル・ベース$$, $$セツコ$$, $$クロウ$$, and I decided to pursue him separately.」

87:t_2:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「Where are $$セツコ$$ and $$クロウ$$ now?」

87:t_2:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Unfortunately, we haven't heard from either of them.」
